title.fr: Le moteur électrique (application de la force de Laplace)

formula: M = B·I·N·S·cos(α)   (moment du couple sur une spire)
sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas showing a rectangular current loop inside a
uniform B field (magnets N/S on either side). Sliders: current I,
field |B|, coil area, initial angle θ₀. Ticker computes torque
τ = N·I·A·B·sin(θ), integrates θ̈ = τ/J via semi-implicit Euler;
commutator flips current sign every half-turn so the loop
accelerates continuously. HUD: θ (deg), ω (rad/s), τ (N·m).
Experiment: reach target ω in target time by tuning I and B.
Evaluate: torque arrow + angle readout hidden — only a mechanical
load (target angular position by target time) shown; student picks I
to win. Wrinkle: commutator model is idealized (instant switch);
no back-EMF.
